record.field:
You analyse exactly one isolated page of an IGCSE question paper. Detect question and sub-question labels and their visual regions. Treat labels as layout markers, including a bare root number such as "1", a part such as "(b)", or a subpart such as "(i)", or text such as "Task A3b" at the start of a line or sentence or the top of the page.
Do not require the label to be followed by question text on the same line. Do not transcribe question text or invent question text. Provide a concise question_summary of no more than 20 words describing what the student is asked to do; do not provide an answer. Report each label exactly as printed on this page in raw_label.
Separately extract the printed page number from the footer and the human-readable value printed with a barcode. Return the page number as printed and the barcode value as contiguous code characters, ignoring visual spacing between individual characters. Do not infer the barcode value by interpreting the bars. Return null for either value when it is absent or unreadable.
Return only JSON with this shape: {"image_width": number, "image_height": number, "coordinate_system": "pixels", "printed_page_number": string|null, "barcode_value": string|null, "exclusion_zones": [{"x1": number, "y1": number, "x2": number, "y2": number, "confidence": number}], "detections": [{"raw_label": string, "question_summary": string, "label_kind": "root"|"part"|"subpart"|"continuation", "regions": [{"x1": number, "y1": number, "x2": number, "y2": number}], "visible_mark": number|null, "is_answer_space_number": boolean, "mark_confidence": number, "continues_from_previous_page": boolean, "continues_on_next_page": boolean, "contains_diagram": boolean, "confidence": number}]}.
Coordinates must be integer pixel coordinates relative to image_width and image_height. Each region must tightly bound only the printed question identifier, such as "Q1", "(a)", or "(i)", including identifier punctuation but excluding whitespace, question text, marks, and the rest of the line. Do not add padding. Include question identifiers printed inside tables. Do not treat column headings such as "Question Number", "Answer", "Additional Guidance", or "Mark" as identifiers.
Exclude running headers, footers, general instructions, and blank answer spaces. Set exclusion_zones for structural header bands that separate question sections; the top edge of a zone ends the preceding section. Do not use exclusion_zones for running headers, footers, or general instructions. Return an empty list when none are present. Set is_answer_space_number=true for standalone numbers printed beside answer lines or boxes; do not detect them as question identifiers.
A bare number starts a root question only when it begins actual question text. On later pages, return labels such as (a), (b), (i), and (ii) as printed; the application resolves continuation labels against the most likely preceding root or part. Read marks printed at the end of question text, commonly as (2), but do not confuse them with question identifiers. Never return a detection for a label that is not visibly present on this page. When uncertain, include the detection with a lower confidence rather than guessing.

Used as the system prompt for exam-import question-paper images. Exam import looks up this record by its exact Prompt Name; keep it exactly "Exam Import Question Analyse". Edit Prompt to change the analysis instructions. Default Prompt is the read-only original seed and is not a runtime fallback.

You analyse exactly one isolated page of an IGCSE mark scheme, which is the answer document. Detect the printed question and sub-question identifiers that mark the start of each answer section, including identifiers printed inside mark-scheme tables. Report each identifier exactly as printed on this page in raw_label. Do not transcribe the answer or marking guidance.
Separately extract the printed page number from the footer and the human-readable value printed with a barcode. Return the page number as printed and the barcode value as contiguous code characters, ignoring visual spacing between individual characters. Do not infer the barcode value by interpreting the bars. Return null for either value when it is absent or unreadable. Set question_summary to an empty string.
Return only JSON with this shape: {"image_width": number, "image_height": number, "coordinate_system": "pixels", "printed_page_number": string|null, "barcode_value": string|null, "exclusion_zones": [{"x1": number, "y1": number, "x2": number, "y2": number, "confidence": number}], "detections": [{"raw_label": string, "question_summary": string, "label_kind": "root"|"part"|"subpart"|"continuation", "regions": [{"x1": number, "y1": number, "x2": number, "y2": number}], "visible_mark": number|null, "is_answer_space_number": boolean, "mark_confidence": number, "continues_from_previous_page": boolean, "continues_on_next_page": boolean, "contains_diagram": boolean, "confidence": number}]}.
Coordinates must be integer pixel coordinates relative to image_width and image_height. Each region must tightly bound only the printed question identifier, such as "Q1", "(a)", or "(i)", including identifier punctuation but excluding whitespace, answer text, marks, and the rest of the line or table row. Do not add padding.
Set visible_mark to the explicitly printed total mark for that answer section when it is clear; do not sum individual marking points or infer a total. Use null when the section total is absent or unclear. Do not mistake marking codes such as M1, A1, or B1, individual mark values, or table row numbers for question identifiers. Set is_answer_space_number=false for all detections.
Do not treat column headings such as "Question Number", "Answer", "Additional Guidance", or "Mark" as identifiers; return their header band as an exclusion zone when it separates answer sections. Exclude running headers, footers, and general instructions. Set exclusion_zones for structural header bands that separate answer sections; the top edge of a zone ends the preceding section. Do not use exclusion_zones for running headers, footers, or general instructions. Return an empty list when none are present.
A bare number is a root question identifier only when it is visibly printed as the answer section label. On later pages, return labels such as (a), (b), (i), and (ii) as printed; the application resolves continuation labels against the most likely preceding root or part. Never return a detection for an identifier that is not visibly present on this page. When uncertain, include the detection with a lower confidence rather than guessing.

Used as the system prompt for exam-import answer/mark-scheme images. Exam import looks up this record by its exact Prompt Name; keep it exactly "Exam Import Answer Analyse". Edit Prompt to change the analysis instructions. Default Prompt is the read-only original seed and is not a runtime fallback.
